verdict.rationale: Orama's docs confirm a bulk-insert API (`insertMultiple`) recommended for large record counts, addressing the 'bulk import' half of the story, but there is no evidence of any async task/job tracking mechanism, status polling, or completion notification for indexing jobs, nor any documented performance/scale claims for millions of documents. missing for 10: async task/job ID tracking, indexing-completion signals, and millions-scale benchmarks or documentation.
